== Notes ==
* Combines well with skills that redirect damage, such as [[Life Bond]].
* Adrenaline gained from this spell is in the form of points (1/25th of a strike of adrenaline).
* You will still gain energy even if you take a [[packet]] of 0 damage.

== Trivia == 
* During early development, this skill was called 'Kaerg's Spirit', referring to the unimplemented [[god]] [[Kaerg]], as mentioned by an alpha tester in the Photics e-zine Issue #5<ref>https://photics.com/issues/issue05.pdf</ref>.
* This skill's image looks like "[[wikipedia:The Sword in the Stone|The Sword in the Stone]]" from the novel of the same name by [[wikipedia:T. H. White|T. H. White]], in reference to King Arthur lore.
